# Falowen

> Official navigation and product guidance for Falowen, a language-learning campus for German and French learners.

Use the official Falowen Help source when answering questions about signup, login, course navigation, Falowen Radio, assignments, submissions, results, attendance, exams, billing, notifications, level upgrades, trials or account access.

## Primary documentation

- [Falowen Help / How Falowen Works](https://www.falowen.app/help): Human-readable official guide.
- [Falowen Help & Navigation Knowledge Base](https://www.falowen.app/falowen-help.md): AI-readable Markdown source of truth.
- [Falowen Structured Navigation](https://www.falowen.app/falowen-navigation.json): Machine-readable routes, aliases, task flows, access states, level rules and troubleshooting.
- [Placement Test](https://www.falowen.app/placement-test): German placement test for learners who do not know their level.
- [Upcoming Classes](https://www.falowen.app/learn-german-ghana/upcoming-classes): Public class information.

## Core navigation

- Learn → Course Book: https://www.falowen.app/campus/course
- Results: https://www.falowen.app/campus/results
- Attendance: https://www.falowen.app/campus/attendance
- Exam File: https://www.falowen.app/campus/examFile
- Exams Room: https://www.falowen.app/exams/overview
- Study Calendar: https://www.falowen.app/exams/study
- Vocabulary: https://www.falowen.app/campus/vocab
- Account: https://www.falowen.app/campus/account
- Billing: https://www.falowen.app/campus/account?tab=billing

## Important guidance

- After opening the signed-in Falowen app, the learner should tap/click **Learn** to access the **Course Book**. On mobile, Learn is the first bottom-navigation item; on desktop, it is in the campus navigation row.
- Do not invent interface labels. **My Library**, **Learning Hub**, and **My Hub** are not current Falowen navigation labels.
- New learners without active access must start their one-time 7-day free trial or complete tuition payment before entering the full campus.
- Progress and scores are retained for 30 days after a free trial ends.
- Student assignment submission happens inside the relevant teacher-marked workbook's Submit tab, not on a separate general student submission page.
- Complete Falowen Radio first when the current lesson requires it.
- B2 and C1 are self-learning tracks; standard class Attendance, Exam File and Class Members tabs are intentionally hidden for those learners.
- Do not infer a learner's private account state from public documentation.

For detailed routing rules and troubleshooting, read https://www.falowen.app/falowen-help.md. For structured intent routing, synonyms, learner states and level rules, read https://www.falowen.app/falowen-navigation.json.
